text:
Erin (Sales): kicking off the SaltBridge POC — they're migrating from ApexX competitor and want minimal app changes. main asks: prompt parity, token billing differences, and enterprise security checks.
Sam (SE): quick question — are we doing an adapter-only (surface shim) or also recommending prompt templates?
Erin (Sales): adapter + small prompt template tweaks. SaltBridge called out that 'stop' handling and trailing whitespace changed outputs in their baseline tests.
Mike (Infra Eng): can we get expected concurrency? need to size a dev pool and reserve GPUs for the POC.
Erin (Sales): initial traffic: 2 rps avg, spiky to 12 rps, ~8 concurrent streams. EU primary, US secondary.
Alice (Security): throwing the basic security checklist at you: does Redwood provide short-lived API keys, KMS integration for customer-managed keys, audit logs retention, and SOC2 attestation? they also want IP allowlist details.
Erin (Sales): they'll send their full questionnaire later today.
Sam (SE): for prompt parity recommend a two-layer approach: 1) compatibility shim that maps competitor fields to our schema, 2) canonical prompt templates to normalize stops/temperature. Example mapping for template layer: 
```json
{"incoming_template":"user: {{input}}\\nsystem: {{persona}}\\n","outgoing_trim":"rstrip('\n')"}
```
Sam (SE): note about stop tokens: ApexX treats stops as substring so we need post-processing to emulate exact behavior.
Jordan (Sales Ops): pricing question from buyer: will the POC be chargeable? what are dev rates / credits?
Jordan (Sales Ops): our standard: first 100k tokens free as POC credits. beyond that, dev pricing: gen $0.003/token, embeddings $0.0004/embed. we can extend to 250k on request with sales approval.
Erin (Sales): buyer asked whether POC credits can be converted to committed capacity if they sign — can we offer conversion at MSRP less 10%?
Jordan (Sales Ops): yes, credits convert to committed prepaid at a 10% conversion credit. i'll draft terms.
Alice (Security): on KMS: we support AWS KMS and customer-supplied CMKs in Private deployments. For hosted POC we can do envelope encryption and audit logging; we'll need contract language for key custody if they insist on full customer KMS.
Mike (Infra Eng): network details: we'll provide egress CIDRs and a short-lived TLS client cert for mutual TLS on the POC endpoint. delivering CIDRs in ~45m.
Sam (SE): compatibility shim endpoint prototype (internal example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/compat/apexx/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"apexx-lite","prompt":"{{prompt}}","max_tokens":256}'
```
Sam (SE): shim will return fields matching ApexX: `text`, `usage.total_tokens`, `meta.compat=true`. we add a `meta.reasoning_score` header optional for debugging.
Erin (Sales): buyer also worried about billing differences — they measured 20% token delta vs ApexX. can we run a tokenization parity test?
Sam (SE): yes — we can run a parallel tokenization pass and produce a delta report. recommend 10 representative prompts (we can add more) and we'll return token counts + normalized outputs.
Erin (Sales): action items so far: Sam -> send template mapping and tokenization parity script; Mike -> publish CIDRs + mTLS cert plan; Alice -> initial SQ answers and attestation docs; Jordan -> confirm POC credit layout and send proforma for 250k optional credit. I'll schedule a call with SaltBridge for tomorrow 10:00 CET.
Jordan (Sales Ops): noted, i'll create the proforma and share payment link if they want the 250k.
Devbot: Deployment queued to dev-pool-saltbridge at 2024-10-02T14:00:00Z (sha: a1b2c3).
Sam (SE): one more ops note — add model-fallback policy: if semantic similarity (embedding cosine) between our output and baseline < 0.92, fall back to higher-precision variant for that request; TTL 5s to avoid flapping.
Erin (Sales): good. also requested that shim expose an `experiment_id` so SaltBridge can tie outputs to our versions for their audits.
Mike (Infra Eng): will add `experiment_id` header and include it in logs.
Alice (Security): also flag: they require a list of subprocessor vendors for hosted POC. i'll collate and post in the doc thread.
Erin (Sales): perfect. I'll update SaltBridge with this plan and post the customer's security questionnaire when it arrives. thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam (SE): will push a minimal dockerized shim example repo after this thread so engineering can spin it up locally.
Erin (Sales): thanks — closing until we have the SQ and the 10 test prompts.
__notes: Generated realistic presales Slack thread for SaltBridge POC migration from competitor APIs. Single continuous string with messages prefixed by sender names. Matches agents.md schema: required metadata + thread content in 'text'.
